name: Search for a Dark Matter-Induced Annual Modulation Signal in NaI(Tl) with the COSINE-100 Experiment

summary.plain: From 1.7 years of data (97.7 kg yr) COSINE-100 fitted a yearly modulation amplitude of 0.0092 +/- 0.0067 counts per day per kg per keV and a phase of 127.2 +/- 45 days; the experiment is designed as a model-independent test of DAMA/LIBRA's claim.
summary.technical: 1.7 years, exposure 97.7 kg yr, 106 kg NaI(Tl), average background 2.7 cpd/kg/keV in the 2-6 keV region of interest (the abstract does not state the energy range of the fit); chi-squared minimisation (Phys. Rev. Lett. 123, 031302 (2019)).

title: Search for a Dark Matter-Induced Annual Modulation Signal in NaI(Tl) with the COSINE-100 Experiment
why_it_matters: The first annual-modulation fit from the same-target test of DAMA/LIBRA; the abstract frames it as constraints, not a signal.
